नल (लः) 1.
m. A reed; name of a
king; of a monkey; of a demon.
f. (ली) Red arsenic; perfume.
n. (लं) Water-lily; colour.

नाल (लः-ला-लं) 1.
m. f. n. A hol-
low stalk; a tube. (ली) 3.
f. A
stalk; ear piercer; 24 minutes;
pulse.
n. Yellow orpiment.

नलक (कं) 1.
n. Any long bone.

नलकिनी (नी) 3.
f. The knee-cap.

नल-कील (लः) 1.
m. The knee.

नल-कूवेर (रः) 1.
m. The son of
Ku-
vera.

नल-द (दं) 1.
n. Indian spikenard.
f. (दा) Nectar of a flower.

नल-पट्टिका (का) 1.
f. A sort of mat
made with reeds, coarse mat.

नल-मीन (नः) 1.
m. A sprat; a prawn.

नलिका (का) 1.
f. A perfume.

नालिक (कः) 1.
m. A buffalo. (का)
f. A tubular vessel; or stalk;
a plant. (कं)
n. A lotus.

नालीक (कः) 1.
m. An arrow, a
dart; lotus, its fibrous stalk.
n.
An assemblage of lotuses.

नलिन (नः) 1.
n. A lotus or water-
lily; water; indigo.
m. Indian
crane;
Karonda. (नी)
f. Assem-
blage of lotuses, &c.; pond; a
stalk of the lotus.

नलिनी-रुह (हः) 1.
m. Brahmā; fi-
bres of the lotus stalk.

नलिने-शय (यः) 1.
m. Viṣṇu.

नल्व (ल्वः) 1.
m. A furlong, 400 cubits.

नल्व-वर्त्म-गा (गा) 1.
f. The orange tree.

नालि (लिः) 2.
f. Any tubular vessel.

नालिकेर (रः) 1.
m. A cocoanut.

नालि-जङ्घ (ङ्घः) 1.
m. A raven.

नालिता (ता) 1.
f. A sort of potherb.

नालीकिनी (नी) 3.
f. A multitude
or assemblage of lotus flowers.

नाली-व्रण (णः) 1.
m. A fistulous or
sinous sore, or wound.
